wf_tag: Wf-131 Phase 1 — 5-metal multi-task D-MPNN with Wasserstein pIC50 regularisation (Ru AUC rescue)
honest_framing_note: Wf-131 P1 stacks multi-task (shared encoder + 5 per-metal heads) + Wasserstein pIC50 regularisation + L2 gradient-norm guard.  Smaller metals (Rh/Os/Re < 1.2k rows) give noisier per-seed AUC; per-seed spread is reported unfiltered.  The Ru AUC ≥ 0.86 target is PROJECTED (party-twenty-spirit §3.5), not measured — the recipe stack has not been validated end-to-end on this cohort, so we report mean ± std honestly and let the per-seed metrics speak for themselves.
